senses.definition: An area where water that is not salty soaks or covers the ground often enough to shape what lives there.
senses.example: Water stood in the freshwater wetland long after the field dried.

senses.definition: One of the thin bars across the neck of a guitar or similar instrument, used to guide where a string stops vibrating.
senses.example: She pressed the string just behind the third fret.

senses.definition: A force that acts between touching surfaces to resist sliding, or that can stop them from starting to slide.
senses.example: Friction between the tires and the road helped the bicycle turn.

senses.definition: A shorter word for refrigerator, a cabinet that stays cold to keep food fresh.
senses.example: We put the milk in the fridge.

senses.definition: A person you know, like, and enjoy spending time with.
senses.example: My friend and I read the same book.

senses.definition: Kind and easy to get along with.
senses.example: A friendly neighbor helped me carry the box.

senses.definition: To make someone or something feel afraid.
senses.example: A sudden shout can frighten a cat.

senses.definition: The side that faces forward, or the leading part of something.
senses.example: I stood at the front of the line.

senses.definition: At or near the side facing forward.
senses.example: I left my shoes by the front door.

senses.definition: The boundary between two large bodies of air with different conditions.
senses.example: A cold front brought rain overnight.

senses.definition: A layer of ice crystals that can form on surfaces when they are cold enough.
senses.example: Frost made the grass look white in the morning.

senses.definition: To cover something with ice, sugar icing, or a coating that looks similar.
senses.example: We used white icing to frost the cake.

senses.definition: To pull your eyebrows together or turn your mouth down to show worry, dislike, or deep thought.
senses.example: I frowned when I saw the torn page.

senses.definition: An expression made by pulling your eyebrows together or turning the corners of your mouth down.
senses.example: Her frown showed she was puzzled.

senses.definition: The part that develops from a flowering plant’s ovary and usually contains seeds.
senses.example: A cucumber is a fruit even when you use it in a salad.

senses.definition: A material that is used as a source of energy, such as wood or a liquid used in some engines.
senses.example: The bus stopped to get more fuel.

senses.definition: To give something fuel or cause an activity or feeling to grow stronger.
senses.example: Questions about the stars fueled her interest in science.

senses.definition: The point that a lever turns around.
senses.example: The support under the middle of a seesaw is its fulcrum.

senses.definition: Enjoyment or something that gives you pleasure.
senses.example: We had fun playing cards on the porch.

senses.definition: Enjoyable or entertaining.
senses.example: Our class made a fun game out of the spelling practice.

senses.definition: In programming, a group of steps a program can use as one unit, often by calling it by name.
senses.example: One function draws a star where the player taps.

senses.definition: An amount of money set aside for a particular purpose.
senses.example: Our club started a fund to buy art supplies.

senses.definition: To provide money to pay for something.
senses.example: The school will fund the new reading program.

senses.definition: A living thing such as a mushroom, mold or yeast that gets food by absorbing it from other material.
senses.example: The fungus absorbed food from a fallen log.

senses.definition: Making people laugh.
senses.example: My cousin told a funny story.

senses.definition: Odd or hard to explain.
senses.example: I heard a funny little noise under the steps.

senses.definition: Movable things such as chairs, beds, and tables that people use in a room.
senses.example: The only furniture in my room is a bed, a desk, and a chair.

senses.definition: The time after the present.
senses.example: Who will use this park in the future?

senses.definition: Expected to happen, exist, or be used later.
senses.example: We kept the extra seeds for a future garden.
